faq.q: Does every sudoku have exactly one solution?
faq.a: Yes. Each puzzle is checked by a solver that counts solutions and stops at two. Any puzzle with more than one answer is thrown away, and the tool's own tests re-check every puzzle with a second, independent solver.

By the hardest technique a solver needs and by the number of givens. Easy puzzles need only naked and hidden singles. Medium needs pairs or pointing, Hard needs triples, X-Wing or XY-Wing, and Expert needs techniques such as Swordfish or XY-Chains. No puzzle needs guessing. The table under the tool lists the rules.

faq.q: Can I sell books made with these puzzles?
faq.a: Yes. The puzzles are generated for you and are yours to print and sell, including on Amazon KDP. Give the book your own title, cover and selection of difficulty levels.

faq.q: Why do I get the same puzzles every time?
faq.a: Puzzles come from the seed, so the same seed and settings always give the same book. That lets you rebuild a book later. Press ↻ or type a new seed for different puzzles.

faq.q: How many puzzles per page should I use?
faq.a: One per page for large print, two per page for most books on 6 × 9 or 8.5 × 11 in, and four or six per page for compact books and worksheets. The tool shows the printed cell size so you can check the grids aren't too small to write in.

faq.q: Is a sudoku book a low-content book on KDP?
faq.a: Generally not. KDP's help lists puzzle books among the examples that usually aren't low-content, so you publish it as a regular paperback and can use a free KDP ISBN. Read KDP's current low-content page before publishing.
